title: flywheel: flywheel_impl_tick input
description: Cursor implementation supervision tick (~4 min cadence): snapshot beads/commits, trigger commit-batch fresh-eyes (Task + verdict file), advance waves when closedBeadIds provided, and return impl Task specs. Re-call on interval until queue drains. Set state.commitBatchThreshold at impl pre-flight (or FW_COMMIT_BATCH_THRESHOLD).

closedBeadIds.description: Beads closed since the previous tick — runs flywheel_advance_wave when non-empty

coordinatorAgent.description: Optional Agent Mail name for inbox probes

commitBatchThreshold.description: Persist commit-batch fresh-eyes threshold for this session (0 = disable). Also readable from flywheel.config.yaml impl_tick.commit_batch_threshold or FW_COMMIT_BATCH_THRESHOLD.
